blocks.x: So what else did I want to tell you, I wanted to tell you something -- oh, I know what it was -- leaving to come back to do this picture that Nazzarro sent a telegram to us while we were finishing up Transatlantic Rhythm --
Before you go on to going back -- Transatlantic Rhythm --
Was the show I told you about.
I know. What was the show about?
Just a variety show. There was no story form, just variety.
